{{Quote|Display map activated. You are here.|Voice of a location monitor|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
A '''location monitor''' was a visual aid device that informed a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] of their current whereabouts. They contained [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[display map]]s, which revealed a three-dimensional outline of whatever was input into the location monitor's [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. [[Empress Teta/Legends|Tetan]] [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|aristocrats]] [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] accessed a location monitor during their visit to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in order to find the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Museum of Dark Side Antiquities]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the comic version of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising|''The Freedon Nadd Uprising'']], the Ketos locate the Museum they are searching for through the use of a guide book. The location monitor is not used nor displayed.
